table.name: order_export
table.description: Fictional order-export table defined by the supplied fictional brief.
table.source_mapping_evidence: Fictional brief explicitly lists all nine columns and states the ID, date, money, currency, total, status, and null/blank rules.

fields.name: order_id
fields.definition: Opaque identifier for an order; no business meaning is inferred from its characters.
fields.allowed_values: Any non-empty opaque string supplied by the source export.
fields.source_mapping_evidence: Fictional brief: IDs are opaque strings; order_id is listed as a field.

fields.name: ordered_on
fields.definition: Store-local calendar date on which the order was placed, formatted as ISO YYYY-MM-DD.
fields.allowed_values: Valid ISO calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form.
fields.source_mapping_evidence: Fictional brief: store local calendar date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD; timezone is unknown and open.

fields.name: customer_ref
fields.definition: Opaque customer reference supplied by the export, when present.
fields.allowed_values: Any non-empty source-supplied string or JSON null.
fields.source_mapping_evidence: Fictional brief: customer_ref is listed and may be null.

fields.name: currency
fields.definition: Currency code applying to the money fields in this export.

fields.name: item_subtotal_minor
fields.definition: Nonnegative item subtotal expressed in integer minor currency units.
fields.allowed_values: Integer greater than or equal to 0.
fields.source_mapping_evidence: Fictional brief: money values are nonnegative integer minor units.

fields.name: shipping_minor
fields.definition: Nonnegative shipping amount expressed in integer minor currency units.
fields.allowed_values: Integer greater than or equal to 0.
fields.source_mapping_evidence: Fictional brief: money values are nonnegative integer minor units.

fields.name: total_minor
fields.definition: Order total expressed in integer minor currency units.
fields.allowed_values: Integer greater than or equal to 0 and equal to item_subtotal_minor + shipping_minor.
fields.source_mapping_evidence: Fictional brief: money values are nonnegative integer minor units and total=subtotal+shipping.

fields.name: status
fields.definition: Current order lifecycle status supplied by the export.
fields.source_mapping_evidence: Fictional brief: status must be one of new, processing, shipped, or cancelled.

fields.name: source_ref
fields.definition: Optional source-system reference; a blank string means the column is present with no reference value.
fields.allowed_values: Field may be absent; if present, an empty or non-empty source-supplied string.
fields.source_mapping_evidence: Fictional brief: source_ref may be blank or a string.

value_presence_rules.missing_field: The column is absent from a row or schema; this is permitted only for optional source_ref and is different from a present null or empty string.
value_presence_rules.null: JSON null; permitted for customer_ref only under this fictional brief.
value_presence_rules.empty_string: A present string with zero characters; permitted for source_ref only and not equivalent to null.
value_presence_rules.required: Eight columns are required in the export schema. customer_ref is required but nullable; source_ref is optional.
